title: Preserve data round trips across output modes

context.hint: Verify the HTML embedding boundary and preserve structured data round trips.
context.surface: A generator emits structured JSON data as either standalone JSON or embedded HTML.
assumptions: Use synthetic values and a local HTML parser.

review.invariant: Context-appropriate encoding preserves the decoded data and standalone JSON behavior.
review.verification: Compare the JSON decoded from the HTML element with the original fixture. Verify the standalone format separately and include a Unicode control.

source_observation.summary: All three targeted tests passed on the repaired copy and after a fresh patch application. The related suites passed 159 tests. The full suite still reported 10 failures.
